x<-which(data$Call=="AAA") will give you the row indices where Call=="AAA"
Thanks

messages.author: e163275d9669c930
messages.subject: Re: Select Rows
parts:
1) Open MS.Excel
2) File -> Open then select your file
3) in file type select All Files Then Select your file
4) in Import Dialog Box That appear Select Deliminated Radio Button
select NEXT
5)Select Deliminator == Space and Treat consecutive deliminater
6) select Finish
7)if alla thing seems Right in MS Excel goto Data Filter Auto Filter
8) Go to Column "Call" and Select "AAA"
9 Copy all items and paste in a new Worksheet
